title: The Flamenco show was...
text: The Flamenco show was amazing to watch. This is an experience that everyone that visits Valencia must do. We met an amazing couple on the tour and the tour operator was amazingly knowledgeable about the city and was very friendly.  It felt like a friend we knew for a ling time.
author: Elvia_P

title: Flamenco and tapas
text: Our guide Manuel Jesus was great!  Took us to great tapas restaurant and explained all the tapas, delicious !     The flamenco show was incredible!   Highly recommended!
author: Lornabrowncastelazo

title: Seville through Carmen’s eyes
text: What an amazing evening. The performers took our breath away! Then the wonderful tour! Carmen was all you could ask for as a guide - she was so gracious, and she had an incredible amount of great information to share about Seville and Spain’s history and culture. The tapas were great, but Carmen was such a treasure! Our family will always remember our time with her in her beloved, beautiful, vibrant city!
author: Anthony_P

title: Fabulous & authentic Flamenco evening!
text: What a fabulous evening this was. Nieves was the most amazing guide who was so very knowledgeable and took us to some awesome restaurants for tapas and wine!! Loved every minute!!  Highly recommend this experience! Must see!!
author: Shailendri_R

title: Recommend Highly
text: Our tour guide, Rachel, knew so much about the history of Flamenco and Spain.  We even got to geek out over one of the jails where Cervantes was incarcerated!!  He was such a rogue!  The Flamenco show was riveting.  Being one of the first shows back since the beginning of the pandemic, the dancers and "band" seemed especially excited to be performing.  We absolutely recommend the tour.
author: Dewanda_K

title: Experience of 10
text: 100% recommended any experience with this group!!!! We loved it!!!! We will repeat again soon!!!
author: Cristina I

title: Great experience
text: Fantastic Service, a little warmth in the flamenco show but nothing that can be blamed on Sevilla4Real.
author: Toblaer

title: Very successful tour
text: Great guide, in a nutshell and not too long, the sherry super delicious, we could choose between 3 different and the flameco show very passionate and inspiring. Would book again.
author: ReiseAnne123

title: Well worth it, there were only two...
text: Well worth it, there were only two of us in the group so it was a personal guided tour. The guide, Daniel, was excellent and knowledgeable.
author: Kathleen C

title: Daniel the tour guide was very...
text: Daniel the tour guide was very knowledgeable about the history of the area and when explain different topics' It was presented in a way , you could ask questions and it was very one on one. The flamenco show was fantastic. The performance and location was perfect. I would highly recommend.
author: Maurice C
